title: Publish v0.17.6: stored tenant plans, platform-scoped tenant operations reads, compat tenant-scope closure and password accessibility
goal: Publish the five merges that landed after the v0.17.5 tag (PR #423, #424, #427, #426, #425) as the next consumable foundation release pantheon-base-v0.17.6 so pantheon-ops can advance its pin and consume tenant operations. Plan definitions move out of the hardcoded GetDefaultQuota switch into the tenant_plans table through migration 000030; three platform-scoped read surfaces land behind /system/tenant-ops/* with five new permission codes and a new Tenant Operations menu group; the compat-mode tenant scope that six services discarded is pinned; five defects found while driving the running system are fixed; every password surface gets an accessible name guarded by check:password-toggle; and the frontend cross-layer boundary baseline is emptied by promoting MenuNode to frontend/src/api/menu.ts. Unlike v0.17.5 this release does change the database (schema 29 to 30) and adds routes, permission codes and menu seeds. Quotas stay display-only: no request is rejected because a plan threshold was crossed.
findings: R1 (P1, fixed in be75b54d / PR #424): under compat the resolved tenant context (tenant_id 0) was discarded by six services, so single-tenant screens read every tenant's rows and dict/dept deletes could not target the caller's record.
R2 (P1, fixed in c1b1d702 / PR #427): saving a role did not propagate to the Casbin enforcement view, so the granted set and the enforced set diverged.
R3 (P2, fixed in c1b1d702): switching to another tenant inside the same tenant returned 500; confirming a security event returned the wrong error code; a password reset left the lock counters intact.
R4 (P1, fixed in c1b1d702): the permission workbench and department paths leaked across tenant scope.
R5 (P2, fixed in c1b1d702): plan thresholds lived in a Go switch, so the platform console could not state what a plan grants without a code release.
R6 (P2, fixed in c1b1d702): Arco's Input.Password rendered its visibility toggle without an accessible name on ten password surfaces, and <html lang> did not follow the active locale.
R7 (P2, fixed in c1b1d702): the generator table picker listed every table regardless of the module scope, and the department dialog could submit the parent placeholder the backend rejects.

R8 (P2, closed by executing the ratchet in c1b1d702): platform/widgets.tsx imported system/iam/menu/api; the violation was frozen in config/boundary-baseline.json. MenuNode is now in frontend/src/api/menu.ts and the baseline has no entries.

R9 (P3, registered open as FR-016 / FR-017): check-evidence, check-review, check-runtime-evidence and check-inheritance-contract have no npm script and appear in no workflow, and check-boundaries only ever runs with a baseline, so a schema or boundary addition retroactively rots older artifacts with no failing signal. Wiring them into CI is a maintainer gate-policy decision.

R10 (P3, environment limitation): the 16 generator tests in backend/modules/lowcode/dynamicmodule fail locally with module.generate.server_export_failed because Go's exec.LookPath("node") cannot resolve the Git Bash /d/nodejs PATH form. With PANTHEON_NODE_BIN and PANTHEON_WORKSPACE_ROOT set the package is green; this is the already-documented F5 in .harness/evidence/2026-10-24-single-tenant-scope-closeout/summary.md, not a regression introduced here.

R11 (P3, environment limitation): dependabot-triggered runs cannot read the RELEASE_GATE_TOKEN repository secret, so Automate Solo PR fails on those runs (Bot approval not permitted, and the merge commit does not trigger push workflows). The context is not required for merge; recorded, not worked around.

implementationNotes: The version is a patch (0.17.6) because v0.17.1 through v0.17.5 are all patches on the release/0.17 line; the release line stays unchanged for cut-foundation-release.mjs.
cut-foundation-release.mjs does not read RELEASE_NOTES_*.md automatically, so --release-notes, --upgrade-notes and --consumer-impact must be passed explicitly.

publish-foundation-release.mjs refuses to continue unless the latest Release Gate Summary check-run on the target commit succeeded, so the release target is the merge commit of this packet, not any earlier head.
The 16 local generator failures are the documented F5 environment limitation: set PANTHEON_NODE_BIN and PANTHEON_WORKSPACE_ROOT before reading a backend suite result.

README and STATUS named the tag and the four assets before publication; the tag object, asset checksums and run ids are now recorded from the live release, and this publication-facts commit closes the loop the same way v0.17.5 was closed by PR #423.
This is not a schema-neutral release: migration 000030 must run, new permission codes only grant the new pages, and 租户管理 moved under the new 租户运营 group.
